original_test_intent: Validate the Type 42 Length byte as an exact bound for the revision-specific formatted structure and variable interface payload, with valid subsequent string termination and reboot stability.
original_method: Read raw offset 01h, apply the advertised-revision minimum/layout, reconcile declared formatted length with interface-specific data-length fields and available bytes, verify the following string-set boundary and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user selects the applicable revision/OEM policy and approves reboot; byte-level bounds validation is automated.
required_inputs: Advertised SMBIOS version and corresponding Type 42 minimum/layout
Raw table access with structure and string-set boundaries
safety_requirements: Read tables only; never repair firmware or reset/reconfigure the controller.
Bounds-check before interpreting any field or interface-specific byte.
Do not use a displayed Length line as proof of reachable payload/string termination.
Stop on management/host health loss and do not auto-retry reboot.
agent_execution_scope: Parse raw length, revision minimum, payload sublengths and table bounds, prove string-set reachability/termination, and diff each record across reboot.
Report underlength, overrun, truncation, mismatch or unexplained drift without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve revision-specific layout and OEM/extra-data handling plus reboot recovery.
Adjudicate documented vendor extensions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove raw offset, revision-specific minimum, variable payload reconciliation or string boundary.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw Type 42/string areas and emit handle/raw length/revision minimum/payload calculations/formatted end/string terminator and pre/post result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Length scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no controller/table mutation is added.

modernized_recommendation.status: REVISION-AWARE LENGTH AND PAYLOAD BOUNDS VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate raw offset-01h length against the selected layout, reconcile nested data lengths, prove formatted/table/string boundaries and compare complete records across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS entry-point, BIOS/BMC, raw parser/dmidecode and management-interface versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 42 revision-specific minimum, data-length and structure/string termination definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces formatted length grep with byte-accurate nested-boundary proof.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects truncated/overrunning records, inconsistent interface-specific data lengths and unreachable string terminators.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Revision layout and documented OEM-data policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A structurally valid length does not prove interface behavior; functionality requires a separate transport test.

project_override_considerations: Projects may accept documented OEM extensions, but cannot waive advertised-revision minimums, nested payload reconciliation or table bounds.
expected_evidence: Approved SMBIOS revision/layout and OEM policy
Pre-reboot raw Type 42 records/string areas with handles and length bytes
Per-record minimum, nested-payload, formatted-end and terminator calculations
Statement that no table/controller/interface state changed
Approved reboot/management health record and post-reboot structural diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Length is a valid Type 42 header field; revision-aware bounds are its required semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw bounds/termination validation is fully automatable after revision/OEM inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw offset, revision minimum, nested payload and string termination checks.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains full structural safety while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates revision/OEM/reboot inputs and formal verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible displayed length from passing when it truncates payload, overruns the table or makes the string area unreachable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Length is a framing invariant; it must agree with the selected layout, all contained variable fields and the next table boundary, not just fall within a numeric range.
